card.name: Mid-sentence in how-to instructions
card.fires_on: Words inside step-by-step instructions, especially in a "To [verb]..." opener (reconstitute, administer, re-prime) and linking words such as by or and within a preparation or use step.

modes.label: To + action opener
modes.description: The ending of a verb after "To" that begins a preparation or use step.

modes.label: Linking word in a step
modes.description: A small word like by or and inside a direction about doing something with a device or product.
modes.example: Administer the resulting solution using the 3 mL or 10 mL oral syringe provided<< by>> the pharmacy [see How Supplied/

modes.label: Choose/select instruction
modes.description: A noun in a web instruction telling the reader how to choose or browse.
modes.example: To choose the<< question>> of your choice, simply browse the list

card.writes: It favors action verbs for instructions, such as click, call, take out, delete and write down.
card.plain: It marks spots in how-to directions where the text is about to tell the reader what action to do next.
